name: map-isometric
question: docs/TICKETS.md T-17 is Hank's standing ruling on the town map: 'fix scale, keep isometric'. Every rule in MAP-PROMPT-RULES.md R1-R8 was measured against the FLAT top-down skeleton, so none of them is known to hold in isometric — this round re-measures. x1 vs x2 isolates the scale clause; x3 is the flat control at the same seed and subject so the projection cost is visible; x4 checks a second biome; x5 checks a route; x6 checks the Sanctum through the no-buildings skeleton, since the Sanctum has no buildings and the map-town skeleton mandates them.
